# Approved output baseline

`site-baseline.json.gz` contains the two full per-file SHA-256 manifests retrieved from **successful** [Actions run 45413171553](https://github.com/waydefu/-rust-learning/actions/runs/45413171553), commit `84ce4a16baaf6d7b1bb3ba61375a335563001f2c`, artifact `14932370146`. At that commit the old Node oracle and native renderer matched 50 files byte-for-byte plus the render report semantically, and Rust-anything replay passed. The fixture is an actual downloaded artifact transformed to JSON keyed by deployment base and gzip-compressed, not generated from the replacement code. Original compressed fixture SHA-256: `b1676558cd86ae8294f9ec63a571ee19b426675fb6b1d62672d23a3b767e9105`. Each base has 51 files.

Run `npm run test:regression` at each supported base. Candidate manifests are written to `.regression-evidence/` even when comparison fails. For intentional content/output changes, decompress the fixture with `gzip -dc tests/fixtures/site-baseline.json.gz`, compare each affected file hash and rendered content against the candidate, then update **only** reviewed entries and counts. Never regenerate the approved fixture automatically in CI. The initial baseline is permanently retained by Git history. Historical migration source is no longer checked out or executed.
